dct_description_sm:
The West Parry Sound Business Directory dataset is a comprehensive collection of active commercial enterprises. This service allows users to access raw vector data (points) for integration into custom maps, mobile applications, and data science workflows.

Key information included in this service:

  • Business Identification: Operating names.
  • Location Services: Precise geographic coordinates and physical addresses.
  • Contact Information: Phone numbers, website URLs, and social media links.
  • Operational Details: Basic service descriptions.

Purpose: To empower entrepreneurs, researchers, and residents with accessible, high-quality business data. This service supports the "Shop Local" initiative and provides the foundational data for the West Parry Sound Geography Network's public-facing business map.
